input.description: Cloud invoicing and bookkeeping for freelancers
input.long_description: Ledgerly is a hosted invoicing and bookkeeping service for freelancers and small agencies across Europe. Customers sign up for a monthly subscription and use our web dashboard to send invoices, track expenses and file VAT returns. The product is closed-source; we run it as a small commercial team and do not publish our code. We're applying because a few customers asked whether donations could go toward a 'community edition' we might build one day.
input.application_message: We'd like to set up a way for our users to contribute financially toward development of the product they rely on.
